name: aktion-tools
description: The Aktion DSL toolchain for Claude Code — author, validate, and preview Aktion applications.

plugins.name: aktion
plugins.description: Write applications in Aktion, a declarative DSL that renders to a live UI from one web component. Adds /aktion, which builds a complete app from a one-line request, checks it against the 282-component schema, and leaves you a runnable page.
